The '''Hall of Fame''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s honour roll for Star Wars CCG players and volunteers. The Players Committee enshrines members of the community for successful and skilled play and for contributions to the game.<ref name="awards" /> The first class (four players) was enshrined on 10 August 2013 at the [[2013 World Championship]].<ref name="awards" /> Most later classes have been enshrined at a World Championship; two were enshrined on 27 April 2019 and one at the [[2023 San Diego Super Open]].<ref name="awards" /><ref name="sdso" /> [[Joe Olson]]'s 2021 induction was made by the Advocate Council and Tournament Committee.<ref name="wrap2021" /> Hall of Famers receive an automatic berth into Day 2 of every later World Championship.<ref name="awards" /> By 2025 there were 17 inductees, each with a Hall of Fame community card.<ref name="cc" />

Recent inductees were introduced by friends or family: [[Phil Aasen]] announced Olson with a poem before Game 1 of the 2021 main event;<ref name="wrap2021" /> [[Bill Kafer]] presented Shaw, with Shaw's parents in attendance;<ref name="wrap2023" /> [[Chris Menzel]] presented Jaap, and [[Eric Hunter]] presented his brother Hayes;<ref name="wrap2024" /> and [[Mike Kessling]], Fred's New Allies teammate, presented Fred.<ref name="wrap2025" />

[[Bastian Winkelhaus]] is the only player enshrined in both the [[Decipher]] Hall of Fame and the Players Committee Hall of Fame.<ref name="awards" />

== Other awards ==
The same Players Committee page lists other community awards:<ref name="awards" />
* '''Lifetime Achievement Award:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] received one from the players in 2011 ([[:File:Scott Lingrell Lifetime Achievement Award.png|photo]]). European players dedicated one to [[Chris Menzel]] at the [[2012 World Championship]], which earned him the title "Euro Emperor".<ref name="awards" />
* '''Player of the Year:''' awarded to the player with the most tournament points in a calendar year. Winners: 2003 [[Justin Desai]], 2004 [[Reid Smith]], 2005 [[James Booker]], 2006 [[Nate Meeker]], 2007 Desai, 2008 [[Kevin Shannon]], 2009 [[Aaron Nelson]] (Rookie of the Year: [[Jerry Heine]]), 2013 [[Steve Baroni]], 2014 [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]], 2015 [[Joe Olson]], 2016 [[Tom Kelly]], 2017 [[Jonny Chu]], 2018 [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], 2019–2021 Olson, 2022 Desai and 2023 [[Hayes Hunter]].<ref name="awards" />
* '''Volunteer Awards:''' given since 2013 for work on the game's websites, software, tournaments and other tools. Since 2021 they include the advocate awards and the John Anderson Volunteer of the Year Award.<ref name="awards" />
